personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply immersive personal media vault where the content is the hero and the UI fades into glass and shadow.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Featured/Hero poster cards with text overlay
dont's: Any surface without at least 75% dark tint underneath

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Immerse the user in the cinematic mood while providing fast access.

states.loading: Blur over hero image with spinner

screens.layout: Full-bleed poster image with top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. Glass container at the bottom holding Google/Apple auth buttons.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A personalized feed of recently added AI discoveries and collections.

states.empty: Empty theater image + 'Your memory vault is empty' + primary CTA.

screens.layout: Poster-driven horizontal carousels (Letterboxd style) with minimal chrome. Generous 'lg' spacing between sections. Sticky FAB at bottom right for Add Discovery. Glass bottom tabs.

screens.name: Add Discovery
screens.purpose: Fastest possible flow to save a URL or text.

states.loading: Processing state with AI sparkle icon

screens.layout: Bottom sheet pattern popping over the Home screen. Minimalist 'Pocket' style: single text input + 'Save to List' primary CTA. Quick close.

screens.name: Personal Library
screens.purpose: Browse the entire saved collection visually.
screens.layout: 3-column edge-to-edge poster grid with 4pt gap (md/lg spacing on edges). Sticky glass header with inline filters (Movies / TV / Custom). No text on grid, just posters to mimic a real shelf.

screens.name: Movie Detail
screens.purpose: Immersive display of a specific title and the user's notes.
screens.layout: Edge-to-edge cover image with strong vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse). Title superimposed over the scrim in Fraunces. Glass layered cards for Cast and Discovery Source (where the user found it). Sticky CTA 'Log Watch Status' pinned at bottom.

screens.name: Semantic Search
screens.purpose: Natural language chat-style input to query the vault.
screens.layout: Conversational UI layout. Clean input field at the bottom within a KeyboardAvoidingView. Results appear above as rich poster cards with glass overlays explaining *why* it matched (e.g., 'Matches: time travel').

poster_1.alt: Cinematic poster of woman in lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Always apply a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim when text overlays an image, fading to ≥75% surface/surfaceInverse at the bottom to ensure WCAG AA contrast.
BANNED: Any hue of blue, indigo, violet, or purple. Stick strictly to the Charcoal Slate + Antique Gold palette provided.
Do NOT use pure #FFFFFF for text; use #F5F5F5 or #EAEAEA as defined in onSurface to reduce OLED eye strain.
Use 'Phosphor' icons consistently. Do not mix weights. Keep them either all outlined or all filled (except tab bar states).
For the Personal Library grid, replicate a Letterboxd-style layout: tight 3-column posters with no text underneath, letting the cover art do the talking.
Any bottom sheets or floating elements must use a frosted glass effect (expo-blur) with a tinted background of at least 70% opacity.
